metadata.description: A scope razor and a claim checker. They read structure and truth separately, because those fail independently.

plugins.name: occams-razor
plugins.description: Cuts parts added for symmetry, completeness, or elegance rather than because a question requires them. Einstein's formulation: as simple and as few as possible, without surrendering the adequate representation of a single datum of experience. Both halves bind.

plugins.name: check-claims
plugins.description: Catches statements that are fluent and wrong: numbers whose source nobody can name, thresholds attached to the wrong metric, facts true of a neighbouring concept, and figures that lost their referent when something was edited.
